gen-dafont-nulshock-satoshi: Stretched out and technical, Nulshock lays down a steady outline with plenty of room between letters. Satoshi follows in a plain sans with a soaring x-height, and it would swallow a heading shrunk down next to it.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-supreme: Origami draws its letters like a sign-painter's brush at constant width, with lowercase as dense as poured lead type. Supreme keeps its shapes open and crisp beneath.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-fira-sans: Wide-set letters traced in an outline you could follow with a finger give Outrun Future its synthwave authority. Fira Sans stays out of its way.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-bespoke-sans: Balsamiq Sans cuts its strokes like a router channel. Bespoke Sans adds sharp, refined curves with generous gaps before each stem, which makes the stencil-like heading feel even bolder.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp and refined, Bespoke Sans leaves generous gaps where curves meet stems. Baumans brings pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, and a crescent-wrench c opened wide, so the pair feels commanding yet orderly.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-bespoke-sans: Loopy and distinctive, Bellota bends thin tubing into letters whose s ends hang far from the spine. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, tidies up beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-bespoke-sans: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace gives each character its own beat, with counters left open to the outside. And Bespoke Sans carries a longer read with sharp curves that stay clear of their stems.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Bruno Ace SC spaces its letters like beads on a long thread, with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning. Bespoke Sans keeps things sharp.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-bespoke-sans: A horseshoe-wide c and heavy diagonals give Cherry Swash a commanding look. Bespoke Sans sits against it as a refined sans, its curves leaving generous space before each stem.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-bespoke-sans: Strokes drawn with one fixed nib, no thicker going up than across, make Comic Relief bold and slightly unfinished at the bowls. Bespoke Sans brings sharpness to that looseness, and the pair gets its edge there.
